name: Powerful Thrower (Combat)
body:
You fend off foes with one hand while making a thrown attack with the other.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack

Benefit(s): When making a thrown weapon attack you may apply Power Attack to the attack and damage roll.

For every -1 on the attack roll you apply from Power Attack you increase the range increment of the attack by 10 feet. This does not stack with additional damage from the Deadly Aim feat.
